versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-daily-hot-keywords:

- Provides tools for searching Douyin's daily hottest videos, real-time hot keywords, creator posts, and video comments analysis.
- Supports keyword-based video/text search with sort and filter options.
- Enables fetching Douyin hot search/leaderboard data, creator public works lists, and detailed comment analysis.
- No Douyin login required; operates securely and only fetches public data.
- Designed for topic research, competitor analysis, trend tracking, and social listening on Douyin.
- Requires configuration of GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
